Survey is now at 392 lines, enriched with findings from both research agents. Final additions from the second agent:

- **GridMind** (Argonne National Lab) — multi-agent LLM system for power grid control rooms
- **Honeywell Connected Solutions** — RL agents directly controlling HVAC through BMS APIs
- **ISO/IEC TS 22440** (2024) — first AI-specific safety standard (learning constraints, drift monitoring, explainability)
- **EU Machinery Regulation** (2027) — upcoming machinery safety updates for AI
- **Documented failure modes** — distribution shift, integration brittleness, sensor spoofing, emergent multi-agent conflicts, RPA fragility

**Cleanup note:** The research agents created files under `library/domains/technology/` and `library/domains/applied-sciences/` — both non-standard paths. These contain useful raw research but should be reviewed and either consolidated into the survey or removed. The survey text at `library/domains/engineering/domains/tech/domains/computing/texts/agentic-industrial-control-survey-2026.md` is the authoritative deliverable.
